failure_modes.symptom: "One grey square on every wheel hub; the star is missing"
failure_modes.cause: the forge took `east` for the high-x side and blanked the *outer* face
failure_modes.cure: `docs/02`; the outer face of a +x part is `west`

failure_modes.symptom: "It looks perfect in your render, wrong in Blockbench"
failure_modes.cause: a renderer that draws the JSON as written
failure_modes.cure: use `tools/preview/render_model.py`, or mirror x + reverse u

failure_modes.symptom: "The curve still has stair steps"
failure_modes.cause: axis-aligned boxes of shrinking size
failure_modes.cure: tilted links joined corner to corner

failure_modes.symptom: "One edge matches but there is a gap beside it"
failure_modes.cause: a width step left open / a valley not filled
failure_modes.cure: splay box; run both links past the corner

failure_modes.symptom: "I asked you to smooth the steps, not to redesign the nose"
failure_modes.cause: over-reach
failure_modes.cure: fix what was pointed at; keep the rest

failure_modes.symptom: "It flickers"
failure_modes.cause: parallel coplanar faces, often between *tilted* parts or hand-placed wedges
failure_modes.cure: offset 0.02–0.05; the checker works on face polygons in every pose

failure_modes.symptom: "There are cracks in the whitewall"
failure_modes.cause: step faces left in the cube's default colour
failure_modes.cure: paint steps to continue the neighbour (by radius / position; match the face lighting)

failure_modes.symptom: "You painted it nicely but it is hidden"
failure_modes.cause: texture on buried or never-visible faces; or a picture that *should* show is covered
failure_modes.cure: visibility passes; move what must be seen

failure_modes.symptom: "The front looks like the last kart" / "it looks like a lizard, the head plays apart"
failure_modes.cause: reused parts; a motif bolted on
failure_modes.cure: one design language through the whole body

failure_modes.symptom: "The grille sticks out past the tyres and shows its sides"
failure_modes.cause: a face block with nothing joining its ends to the body
failure_modes.cure: flush sides, chamfered corner panels

failure_modes.symptom: "A big cube hangs over the front wheel"
failure_modes.cause: a volume faked with a floating box
failure_modes.cure: real fender + arch lips

failure_modes.symptom: "From the seat I can see the rear wheel through a hole"
failure_modes.cause: cockpit not walled off
failure_modes.cure: tub walls to the bulkhead; sight-line test

failure_modes.symptom: "Only the nose got higher; now it is unbalanced"
failure_modes.cause: a local fix to a global proportion
failure_modes.cure: one shoulder line; raise the rest

failure_modes.symptom: "Pipe stays cross the booster panels when they open"
failure_modes.cause: fixed parts in a moving part's path
failure_modes.cure: everything ahead of the hinge, steeper than the open lean; check every pose

failure_modes.symptom: "The open lid shows its picture to the ground"
failure_modes.cause: leaned back instead of forward
failure_modes.cure: lean forward; test the outward normal

failure_modes.symptom: "The steering column pokes out in front of the windscreen"
failure_modes.cause: cowl too far forward
failure_modes.cure: cowl over the shaft; `shaft_buried` checks the first quarter, not only the tip

failure_modes.symptom: "The dial's 12 points the wrong way"
failure_modes.cause: asymmetric art placed by derivation
failure_modes.cure: verify orientation in game first

failure_modes.symptom: "The physics box is inside the body"
failure_modes.cause: eyeballed footprint
failure_modes.cure: measure (`docs/13`)

failure_modes.symptom: "A dragon's wing is not drawn like that — look at the Ender Dragon" (twice: a flat board, then a fan of boxes)
failure_modes.cause: not looking at how vanilla does it
failure_modes.cure: two jointed segments, each a bone + ONE zero-thickness plate whose scalloped outline and fingers are painted, the rest transparent; `entity_alphatest`

failure_modes.symptom: a two-faced plate flickers
failure_modes.cause: its two faces differ at some point (outline, light, density) and the material draws both
failure_modes.cure: paint by position; same light, density, no grain on both faces

failure_modes.symptom: "Look more closely — what is this?" (square board corners on the folded wing, the membrane cutting through the body, spikes seen edge-on)
failure_modes.cause: each plate was turned with its swept bone, so plates left the wing plane and their uncut corners showed
failure_modes.cure: both plates in ONE wing plane, inner edge exactly on the hinge line, turning about that axis only; cut everything ahead of the bone and outside a deeply scalloped outline; then look at the *folded* pose up close

failure_modes.symptom: the wing is a solid board from below
failure_modes.cause: the visibility pass blanked one face of a two-faced plate to one texel
failure_modes.cure: never blank either face of such a plate; `seen_from_below=True`; the linter reports unequal faces as an error

failure_modes.symptom: "The effect comes out of the wrong place"
failure_modes.cause: locators left at ordinary exhausts while the glowing core rides the transforming part
failure_modes.cure: put the locator in that part's bone, at the core

failure_modes.symptom: a test passes on the defect it was written for
failure_modes.cause: the test measured the wrong thing
failure_modes.cure: break the model and watch the test fail

failure_modes.symptom: "You said eleven fixed; two were not"
failure_modes.cause: reporting from memory
failure_modes.cure: report from the diff

failure_modes.symptom: a save with a cube of size −0.04 on one side
failure_modes.cause: an edge dragged past its opposite face
failure_modes.cure: linter; delete it

failure_modes.symptom: the build takes minutes
failure_modes.cause: per-pixel loops in Python
failure_modes.cure: Node / vectorise; parallel liveries

failure_modes.symptom: seventeen textures weigh megabytes
failure_modes.cause: per-texel grain on a big atlas
failure_modes.cure: `grain=0`; crop the atlas height
